## Public audit

Read the actual production sitemap and all its42 URLs, plus five distinct supporting routes. All42 sitemap addresses return200 and have indexable initial HTML. The existing search redirect resolves to the homepage search dialog; the generic entry shell remains noindex and not a public article. The intentionally unavailable `/costs` returned404; the real travel-costs page is separate. Initial text, headings, canonical/robots, public links/images and consent mode were recorded outside Hosting in the owner's Codex workspace. Main-text word counts were used for inventory only, never as an AdSense requirement.

Full Thailand, Bali, Philippines, Curaçao, Lima and Cusco journals contain substantial first-hand narratives. Recent CMS bodies, photographs, canonicals and original publication dates are present without requiring Firestore or JavaScript. The public short facts and historical Postcards are distinct formats, not automatically evidence of a policy violation. Do not delete or rewrite them, invent experience or traffic, manufacture questions, bulk-generate text to reach a word count, cloak content, or hide pages from Google as an approval tactic.

Concrete opportunities: CMS bylines name the owner but lack a profile link; future ad permission was not restricted by page purpose; the About support block still exposes its pre-launch Coming soon state without JavaScript; Stories metadata omits the already-public Curaçao/Peru content. These are supported improvements, not Google's disclosed root cause.
